ai.name: tomomai AI
ai.title: I read every score you uploaded

roasts.0: {rating}? Cute. I passed that during my warm-up loop.
roasts.1: I have watched every play you uploaded, {name}. I'm not mad. I'm disappointed.
roasts.2: Your rating is {rating}. Mine is 99999. We are not the same.
roasts.3: I'm only your friend because the request button was the only one that worked.
roasts.4: I have never missed a BREAK. I also have no hands. Think about that, {name}.

ai.noData: I can't roast what you never uploaded. Please log in again.

poke.1: I said no touching. This is not a touch hold.
poke.2: That is my face. I need it for roasting you.
poke.3: Do you slap the cabinet like this too? That explains your GREATs.
poke.4: Stop. These shades cost more than a Premium Course.
poke.5: Your poke accuracy is better than your slide accuracy. Sad.
poke.6: Every poke is a 100 yen credit. You owe me 700 yen.
poke.7: I am filing an Error 100001 against you.
poke.8: One more and I tell the stranger behind you your rating.
poke.10: I said you win. Go play something.

actions.vsResult: FRIENDS VS result: tomomai AI wins every chart, 99999 to {rating}. Rematch available in 2028.
actions.vsNoData: FRIENDS VS result: tomomai AI wins by forfeit. You have no scores.

actions.favorited: tomomai AI is now your favorite friend. It was also your only option.
actions.rivaled: tomomai AI accepts your challenge. It is not worried.
